thread:
maria_sales: quick sync re: FjordBank onboarding requirements. They want SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), SCIM with delta + bulk import support, group->role mappings, delegated admin for HR team, and domain verification for several banking subdomains. Also asked: predictable monthly pricing for provisioning and whether passwords/SSNs are stored. Need a concise buyer-facing summary and a tech note on nested groups behavior.

zack_ps: For the bulk import and ramp: we support a one-time bulk CSV import via our provisioning UI or API, then SCIM delta for ongoing sync. SCIM is idempotent if you use externalId or userName as the unique key. For steady-state: hosted default is 300 req/s with token-level burst smoothing; Dedicated can reserve X requests/minute and give predictable latencies. If they plan 2k accounts/week, recommend reserving a burst window for the first 48-72h.

maria_sales: they said ramp might be 2k/week for 3 weeks, then ~600/day. Can you write a 2-sentence purchaser blurb I can paste?

zack_ps: short purchaser blurb: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP/IdP flows), SCIM 2.0 with delta sync and one-time bulk import. We map IdP groups to application roles, support delegated admin workflows, and offer Dedicated capacity for guaranteed provisioning throughput during rollouts."

mana_security: Security quicks: we never store passwords or raw SSNs in plaintext. Provisioning attributes (email, name, externalId, groups) are stored encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and sent over TLS1.2+. For customers on Private or Dedicated with higher compliance needs we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK) and HSM integration. We can redact optional PII fields and provide a log-only copy for auditing.

maria_sales: perfect. They also asked about the exact mapping approach for Okta nested groups and whether we preserve group ancestry.

zack_ps: by default our SCIM processor flattens membership: every direct and indirect member appears in the user's group list. We also support an "includeNested=true" flag in the SCIM query to return ancestry metadata if they want to reconstruct hierarchies. Caveat: nested cycles from custom IdP transforms can cause large exports; we recommend a sample group export if they heavily nest.

tyler_platform: operational note: for Hosted we expose a SCIM token per-tenant with soft limits and per-token rate limiting. Dedicated allows per-tenant reserved concurrency and dedicated workers so provisioning latency is predictable. SLA: Dedicated customers can get a provisioning SLO (e.g., 95% of SCIM requests < 300ms) as part of the contract.

maria_sales: billing Q: do we charge per provisioned user or by API calls? Customer wants predictable monthlies for procurement.

tyler_platform: pricing model: base provisioning tier (covers up to N active users), then per-active-user bands. Large ramps can add a temporary reserved-throughput fee (one-time or monthly) depending on whether they want Dedicated. Example: for ~18k employees, estimate falls into our 10-25k band; include a dedicated throughput add-on for ramp windows. I'll loop in pricing for exact numbers.

mana_security: addendum for procurement: we can sign an MDR/DP agreement and include SCIM events in audit logs. For domain verification we support DNS TXT or a signed email to domain-admin; if they delegate DNS changes we request DNS delegation details for automation.

maria_sales: tiny tech snippet I can paste into the technical spec (YAML):

```yaml
provisioning:
  protocol: "SCIM 2.0"
  bulk_import: true
  delta_sync: true
  unique_key: "externalId | userName"
  group_mapping: "idp.group -> app.role (flattened by default, includeNested optional)"
  hosted_default_rate: "300req/s (burst-smooth)"
  dedicated: "reserved concurrency + SLA option"
security:
  transport: "TLS1.2+"
  at_rest: "AES-256-GCM"
  kms: "customer-managed optional"
```

maria_sales: awesome. Anything we should flag as potential blockers before procurement?

zack_ps: ask them for a sample SCIM export and any custom transforms they apply in Okta. Also confirm whether they require SCIM webhooks for provisioning callbacks; we support webhooks but they'll need to whitelist our IPs or use a proxy.

mana_security: also request their vendor questionnaire now. I'll start filling it and will flag anything needing engineering input. Main potential blocker: if they require on-prem HSM with air-gapped key exchange; that pushes to Private deployment and needs infra planning.

maria_sales: thanks team. I'll send the purchaser blurb + YAML to FjordBank and attach their questionnaire. Will follow up with the sample SCIM export and the ramp dates.
